item.title: Trash and Recycling in a Small Apartment With No Floor Space: A Cabinet-First Setup
item.description: In a small apartment the trash can is usually the thing that ends up in the middle of the floor. Recycling goes into a shopping bag by the door, food scraps go into the bin with everything else, and the kitchen smells like all three by Thursday. This guide builds a compact system around the layout in the cover photo: two bins on a slide inside a lower cabinet, a bag holder on the cabinet door, a lidded crock on the counter and a slim container in the gap beside the refrigerator.
